[package]
name = "moq-net"
description = "The networking layer for Media over QUIC: real-time pub/sub with built-in caching, fan-out, and prioritization."
authors = ["Luke Curley"]
repository = "https://github.com/moq-dev/moq"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
version = "0.2.20"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.91"
keywords = ["quic", "http3", "webtransport", "media", "live"]
categories = ["multimedia", "network-programming", "web-programming"]

[package.metadata.cargo-shear]
ignored = ["getrandom"]

[features]
fuzz = []

[dependencies]
arrayvec = "0.7"
bytes = "1"
futures = "0.3"
num_enum = "0.7"
rand = "0.10.1"
slab = "0.4.12"
thiserror = "2"
tracing = "0.1"
web-transport-trait = "0.4.0"

[dependencies.kio]
features = ["time"]
version = "0.5.8"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.web-async]
version = "0.1.5"
features = ["tracing"]

[dev-dependencies]
criterion = "0.8"
serde_json = "1"

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
features = ["macros", "io-util", "sync", "test-util", "time", "rt"]
version = "1.48"

[target."cfg(loom)".dev-dependencies.loom]
version = "0.7.2"
features = ["futures"]

[target."cfg(target_family = \"wasm\")".dev-dependencies]
wasm-bindgen-test = "=0.3.71"

[target."cfg(target_family = \"wasm\")".dev-dependencies.getrandom]
version = "0.4"
features = ["wasm_js"]

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(loom)"]

[[example]]
name = "fuzz-seeds"
path = "examples/fuzz-seeds.rs"
required-features = ["fuzz"]

[[bench]]
name = "group"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "track"
harness = false
